meta.title: Add C compiler via Cython
meta.body_summary: Add compile/c package to compile Mochi to C via Cython, verified with a LeetCode example.

perf_labels.notes: Author self-closed PR after adding Cython-based C compiler package and a test; no maintainer review or performance evidence provided.
